accepted: versioned manifest binds protocol and UI schema
package assets carry exact size and sha256
runtime nonce CSP forbids unsafe inline/eval
immutable hashed assets and no-store dynamic resources have explicit cache policy
package file allowlist includes manifest and excludes secret patterns
denied: unknown manifest field or duplicate asset path
absolute, parent escaping, symlink or secret asset path
private key or live credential marker in package bytes
old protocol or UI schema without capability negotiation
package and manifest app version drift
package glob that includes .env, token or secret material
CSP downgrade to unsafe-inline or unsafe-eval
